entities.summary: Île Jésus is a river island in southwestern Quebec, separated from the mainland to the north by the Rivière des Mille Îles, and from the Island of Montreal to the south by the Rivière des Prairies. It is the second-largest island in the Hochelaga Archipelago, and the fourth most populous island in Canada, with more than 420,000 residents as of 2016.
